observation: Two attempts in a row produced candidates that passed tests but violated a MUST about append-only storage; neither reviewer checked guidance compliance explicitly.
proposed_change: Require the correctness reviewer to report a compliance status for every MUST guidance item, including not_applicable.
expected_benefit: MUST violations surface in review rather than after integration.
possible_counterexamples: Work Packages with many MUST items may produce noisy compliance lists.
evaluation_plan: Replay the two trajectories with the amended reviewer prompt and check that both violations are reported.
rollback_plan: Revert the reviewer prompt to the previous version.
